notes: Author-run results for the 350,000-step Meituan-Robotics-0 checkpoint, pending official verification. This continues the Human300 training run of the 200,000-step checkpoint previously submitted in PR #37. Both the VLM and action head were fine-tuned with an effective batch size of 256. Evaluation used RoboCasa 1.0.1, pretraining kitchens, all 50 target tasks with 50 episodes each, and 16 executed actions per request. The checkpoint succeeded in 716/900 Atomic-Seen episodes, 449/800 Composite-Seen episodes, and 225/800 Composite-Unseen episodes for 1390/2500 successes overall (55.60%).
